lines.text: Power cuts are an everyday thing in India, and the only record is usually the utility's own. BijliLog is a power cut log for your PIN code, kept by neighbours, and stored on Arkiv.
lines.say: Power cuts are an everyday thing in India, and the only record is usually the utility's own. Bijli Log is a power cut log for your PIN code, kept by neighbours, and stored on Ar-kiv.

lines.text: One tap reports a cut. It is written to Arkiv as a two hour lease. This one is labelled demo, because the data here is synthetic.
lines.say: One tap reports a cut. It is written to Ar-kiv as a two hour lease. This one is labelled demo, because the data here is synthetic.

lines.text: A neighbour on another phone taps Still dark. The confirmation and the lease renewal land in a single transaction, and this page updates live.
lines.say: A neighbour on another phone taps Still dark. The confirmation and the lease renewal land in a single transaction, and this page updates live.

lines.text: When power is back, the cut becomes a permanent record. It is signed by the phone and sealed to an address nobody holds a key for, so nobody, including us, can edit or delete it.
lines.say: When power is back, the cut becomes a permanent record. It is signed by the phone, and sealed to an address nobody holds a key for, so nobody, including us, can edit or delete it.

lines.text: Every row shows its proof: signed, sealed, and a link to the explorer. The calendar shows how often, and for how long.
lines.say: Every row shows its proof: signed, sealed, and a link to the explorer. The calendar shows how often, and for how long.

lines.text: And the payoff is a ready-to-send complaint, in English or Hindi, with a WhatsApp button. It cites the 2020 consumer rights rules and the forum's forty-five days. If any record is demo, it says sample only, do not file.
lines.say: And the payoff is a ready to send complaint, in English or Hindi, with a WhatsApp button. It cites the twenty twenty consumer rights rules, and the forum's forty five days. If any record is demo, it says sample only, do not file.

lines.text: The page reads Arkiv straight from your browser. These are the exact queries it runs, so anyone can check them without our app.
lines.say: The page reads Ar-kiv straight from your browser. These are the exact queries it runs, so anyone can check them without our app.

lines.text: Here is what Arkiv gives us. Expiry is the lease. Permissionless extension lets any neighbour renew it. Atomic batches keep changes together. Sealed records make a finished cut evidence. New reports still go through our relay, and we say that openly.
lines.say: Here is what Ar-kiv gives us. Expiry is the lease. Permissionless extension lets any neighbour renew it. Atomic batches keep changes together. Sealed records make a finished cut evidence. New reports still go through our relay, and we say that openly.

lines.text: That was BijliLog, by Harsha Shinde. Open source. A testnet demo with synthetic data, built with AI assistance. This narration is an AI copy of my own voice.
